meta.title: Seafood Catalogue: Egyptian Fish for Export
meta.description: Fish species AZAFCO supplies for wholesale and export. Sizes, product form and packing are confirmed in writing for each order. Request specifications.

hero.title: Find the species. Confirm the specification.
hero.intro: Choose the species your business needs, then send us your size, form, packing and destination. Sizes, presentation and availability vary with production cycles, demand and market, so every specification is confirmed per order.

grid.title: Species we supply

note.title: Specifications are confirmed per order
note.text: Size grades, product form, packing, net weight and availability are agreed in writing for each order. Prices are given in a written offer based on species, specification, volume, destination and trade terms. We do not publish list prices or stock levels.

specify.title: What helps us prepare an accurate offer
specify.intro: The more precise the request, the faster the export team can confirm what can be supplied.
specify.species_text: The species and the weight range per piece you need.
specify.form_text: Whole or another presentation, and fresh or frozen where offered.
specify.packing_text: Pack type, net weight per pack and any label requirements.
specify.volume_text: Quantity per shipment and whether the order repeats.
specify.destination_text: Country and city of delivery, and the documents your market requires.

custom.intro: Send us the specification you need. We review different sizes or packing against our actual capability and the quantities available, and we only offer an option once it is confirmed.

proof.title: Check the process before you order
proof.processing_text: How orders move from receiving and grading to packing and dispatch.
proof.quality_text: Which specifications, records and documents you can review.
proof.importers_text: How an enquiry becomes a confirmed order.

detail.meta_description: Request {name} for wholesale export from Egypt. Size grade, product form, packing, volume and destination are confirmed in writing per order.
detail.meta_description_short: Request {name} from Egypt for wholesale export. Size, form and packing are confirmed in writing for each order.
detail.intro: Tell us the size grade, product form, packing, volume and destination. Our export team reviews the request and confirms a written specification and offer for your market.
detail.spec_intro: Fields without an approved value are confirmed with the export team for each order.
detail.spec_note: Size grades and pack type are indicative and come from our current product list. The grade, form, packing and temperature requirements for your order are confirmed in writing in the commercial offer.
detail.grading_text: Grades are set by weight range per piece. Tell us your target range, product form and packing, and we confirm which options can be supplied for your order. We do not show stock or availability labels on the website.
detail.docs_text: Tell us which documents your market and your quality team need. We confirm what can be provided for this product and its scope before you order.
detail.faq_sizes_a: That depends on actual availability and your order. Send us your target weight range and we confirm what can be supplied.
detail.faq_packing_a: Custom pack sizes, net weights and labels are reviewed against the specification and the quantity you need.
detail.faq_price_a: No. Prices are issued in a written commercial offer with a stated validity, based on specification, volume, destination and trade terms.
detail.rfq_after_1: We review your specification and quantity
detail.rfq_after_2: The export team contacts you to confirm the details
detail.rfq_after_3: You receive a written offer, subject to confirmed availability

notes.eel: European eel (Anguilla anguilla) is listed in CITES Appendix II and cannot be supplied to buyers in the European Union. Availability for other destinations, and the export permits required, are confirmed with the export team.
